t: This is a stretch of Eaton Square, numbers 103 to 118, in Westminster. The terrace was designed by two members of the Cubitt family. Thomas Cubitt was the master builder who developed many of London's historic streets and squares, especially in Belgravia, pimlico and Bloomsbury. Lewis Cubitt, born some years later, was an English civil engineer and architect. Together their names tie this row to the making of Belgravia, one of the grandest pieces of nineteenth-century London.
